components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: A quiet 44px report anchor that becomes horizontally scrollable below the rail breakpoint.

components.name: Theme Choice
components.description: The compact light/dark segmented control with a low-saturation selected state.
components.css: .ds-theme-switcher{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed);border-radius:11px;background:var(--surface,#fbfcfe)}.ds-theme-choice{display:inline-flex;min-width:42px;min-height:36px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 9px;border:0;border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted,#59657a);background:transparent;font:14px/1.55 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans SC','Noto Sans Thai','Noto Sans',sans-serif}.ds-theme-choice[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent2,#2f50b2);background:var(--accent-soft,#e8edfc);font-weight:680}.ds-theme-choice svg{width:16px}.ds-theme-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: The report's default secondary action for resetting, expanding, and exporting.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;min-height:42px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed);border-radius:9px;color:var(--muted,#59657a);background:var(--raised,#fff);font:620 14px/1.55 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans SC','Noto Sans Thai','Noto Sans',sans-serif}.ds-btn:hover{color:var(--ink,#172033);border-color:var(--line2,#cbd5e2)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The always-visible search entry for products, factors, original text, and translation.
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;min-width:0}.ds-field-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-height:42px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed);border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink,#172033);background:var(--raised,#fff);font:14px/1.55 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans SC','Noto Sans Thai','Noto Sans',sans-serif}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--soft,#748096)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Removable Filter Chip
components.description: An individually removable statement of the active analytical scope.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip{display:inline-flex;min-height:32px;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 8px 5px 10px;border:0;border-radius:999px;color:var(--accent2,#2f50b2);background:var(--accent-soft,#e8edfc);font:650 11px/1.55 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans SC','Noto Sans Thai','Noto Sans',sans-serif}.ds-filter-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-filter-chip-x{font-size:16px}

components.name: Decision Factor Row
components.description: A factor button that combines identity, sample coverage, and a low-profile evidence bar.
components.css: .ds-factor{display:grid;min-height:48px;width:100%;grid-template-columns:minmax(130px,1fr) minmax(120px,2fr) auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;color:var(--ink,#172033);background:transparent}.ds-factor:hover{background:var(--subtle,#f3f6fa)}.ds-factor:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-factor-name strong,.ds-factor-name span{display:block}.ds-factor-name strong{font-size:12px}.ds-factor-name span{color:var(--soft,#748096);font-size:10px}.ds-bar-track{display:block;height:8px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:999px;background:var(--line,#dce3ed)}.ds-bar-fill{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:inherit;background:var(--accent,#4267d5)}.ds-factor-count{min-width:70px;color:var(--muted,#59657a);text-align:right;font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Matrix Evidence Cell
components.description: A product-by-factor cell that applies both filters and encodes positive-versus-negative evidence intensity.
components.css: .ds-heat{min-width:64px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ds-heat-color) 30%,var(--line,#dce3ed));border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink,#172033);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ds-heat-color) calc(var(--ds-heat)*42%),var(--surface,#fbfcfe));font-size:11px}.ds-heat:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-opportunity{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed);border-radius:12px;color:var(--ink,#172033);background:var(--raised,#fff)}.ds-opportunity-summary{display:grid;min-height:66px;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) 20px;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:13px 18px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-opportunity-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-opportunity-summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-opportunity-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}.ds-opportunity-caret{color:var(--soft,#748096);font-size:17px;transition:transform .18s ease}.ds-opportunity[open] .ds-opportunity-caret{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-opportunity-detail{padding:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed);color:var(--muted,#59657a);font-size:12px}.ds-text-button{min-height:40px;padding:5px 0;border:0;color:var(--accent2,#2f50b2);background:transparent;font-weight:680}.ds-text-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#4267d5) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: The Evidence Workbench / 证据工作台
narrative.overview:
The system should feel like a calm operational desk where every summary can be traced back to its source. A cool gray-blue canvas holds paper-white work surfaces; compact typography, thin borders, and restrained low-saturation blue establish hierarchy before decoration. The approved visual lineage is modern Linear + Stripe + Notion operational SaaS, carried forward under seed exemption `incumbent-amazon-voc-user-approved-20260813`.

Its signature is a continuous evidence interaction: a decision-factor matrix narrows the dataset, individually removable filter chips make the active scope visible, and original-language evidence completes the trace. Light and dark modes preserve the same information hierarchy. Product imagery appears only when it is review evidence, never as decorative filler.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray-blue canvas with paper-white work surfaces.
Flat-first hierarchy built from type, alignment, density, and thin structural borders.
One restrained blue interaction voice plus semantic evidence states.
Compact, multilingual, evidence-first reading with full light/dark parity.
A traceable matrix → removable filters → original-language evidence chain.

rules.name: The One Blue Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for interaction, selection, and the evidence path; it does not decorate unrelated surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Teal, rose, and amber communicate positive, negative, and warning meaning only; never use them as general accents.

rules.name: The Offline Legibility Rule
rules.body: Preserve the complete native multilingual fallback stack and never add a network font dependency to the generated report.

rules.name: The Structural Responsive Rule
rules.body: Narrow layouts change hierarchy and grouping; they do not merely scale the desktop composition down.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and structural lines first; elevation is reserved for sticky, selected, or top-level surfaces.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Larger surfaces receive the larger radius; nested controls step down, while only chips and status dots become fully rounded.

dos: Do preserve matrix → removable filters → original-language evidence as one continuous drill-down.
Do use paper-white work surfaces, thin structural borders, and compact type to establish the primary hierarchy.
Do maintain semantic labels, visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, 44px mobile targets, and full light/dark parity.
Do keep review imagery attached to its exact evidence and failure/loading state.
donts: Don't use sample coverage as a market incidence claim or style draft recommendations as verified product facts.
Don't turn the report into a field of elevated cards, decorative gradients, or saturated accent blocks.
Don't hide the active analytical scope; every filter must remain visible and individually removable.
Don't replace original-language evidence with translation, or add external font/image dependencies for decoration.
